links.outcome: Reading grade level of ChatGPT-generated glaucoma surgery handouts versus online webpages
links.effect: No difference between online webpages (12th grade) and ChatGPT responses (11th grade), despite prompts requesting a sixth grade reading level.
links.quote: There was no difference between the reading level of online webpages (12th grade) and the reading level of ChatGPT-generated responses (11th grade), despite the ChatGPT prompts asking for simple language and a sixth grade reading level.

links.outcome: Reading level of patient materials relative to average patient reading level
links.effect: Online patient information and ChatGPT handouts were at 11th-12th grade level, beyond the average patient's reading level, despite a sixth grade target.
links.quote: Patient-targeted information on glaucoma surgery is beyond the reading level of the average patient, therefore at risk of not being understood, and is of subpar quality, per DISCERN tool scoring.

unlisted_practices: Using ChatGPT to automate DISCERN quality assessment of online health information
